pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with soft, pixelated edge gradients. Relative spatial area is heterogeneous, with larger patches on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller shapes toward the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interstitial light pelage forms a continuous network with varied pixel thickness. Junction nodes primarily exhibit trivalent and tetravalent connectivity, with pathway thickness increasing at nodal intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The visible mane along the upper neck boundary exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.
